_comment: The smallest config that works for anyone with an OpenAI API key.
Copy to local/config.json (git-ignored) or point --config at it, then:
jichi doctor        # confirms the key, the endpoint and the roles
No key in this file, ever: apiKeyEnv names the VARIABLE jichi reads.
contextLength is set deliberately BELOW the real window -- jichi's
byte/4 estimate runs optimistic until per-model calibration settles
(docs/COMPACTION.md), and an undeclared window is the single most
expensive omission a config can have (docs/analysis/2026-08-09-hrz-
The embed model powers codebase_search and @docs:; drop that entry if
you do not want retrieval, and jichi simply will not register the tool.
